description: Text to speech (GET) — Turn text into spoken MP3 audio with one GET: text= (max 1500 characters), optional lang= en | es | fr | zh | ja | ko (default en). Returns the audio/mpeg body directly - save it or play it. Same engine as POST /v1/audio/speech (MeloTTS). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
